scope: Adapter workaround for the stock Godot 4.7 script-iterator stack defect: document text with more than 32 emoji sub-runs or 128 open brackets is shaped in pieces. Windows only; the engine defect itself is unchanged.

icu_data.reason: ICU 70+ serves UCHAR_EMOJI*/UCHAR_EXTENDED_PICTOGRAPHIC from uemoji data; without it every emoji lookup is false and no split happens.

findings: The stock 4.7.1 editor still fails five of six standalone reproduction cases; the workaround is in the adapter, not the engine.
All 19,692 adapter checks pass on both editors, including the five new past-limit cases compared glyph-by-glyph against tiled three-unit references.
The Frontier Camp lifecycle harness on the stock editor aborts with a fatal out-of-bounds index using the previous library and completes with the new one.
The autoscroll stress fixture passes with every library and editor, so it does not detect this defect.
limitations: Windows RTX 5080 only; Linux/macOS and other engine versions unverified.
Text in native Godot controls bypasses the adapter and still needs the engine patch.
Sanitizer suites, the full host suite, exports and timing profiles were not rerun for this candidate; it is not installed.
